subject: Strategic leadership hires — Q3 authorization & offer guardrails
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic leadership hires — Q3 authorization & offer guardrails

Team —

I'm sharing the proposed Q3 executive hiring plan for approval. This is focused on two priority roles we discussed last offsite:

- VP Product (12/13 band target) — replacement + strategic hire to lead platform PMs for inference features
- Head of Machine Learning (14 band target) — senior hire to own model serving & evaluation stack

Key asks:
- Sign-off on the headcount and baseline comp bands (attached: comp_bands_2027_v2.pdf)
- Approval for delegated offer authority for recruiter + hiring manager up to the listed ranges in offer_signoff_matrix.csv
- Permission to engage external search partner (TalentAdvisors) for VP Product (budgeted fees in Q3_exec_hiring_plan.xlsx)

Budget impacts are minimal vs runway but the two hires are strategic for product velocity and model quality. Attached is the detailed spreadsheet with salary + equity scenarios and an offer sign-off matrix.

Proposed timeline: shortlist by mid-May, offers in early June, onboards by July 1 (staggered where necessary).

Please reply with: APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS / DENY. If APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS, state the condition(s).

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_exec_hiring_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), comp_bands_2027_v2.pdf (PDF), offer_signoff_matrix.csv (CSV)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic leadership hires — Q3 authorization & offer guardrails

Aditya —

APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. High-level OK from my side; two conditions before offers go live:

1) VP Product: include a 90-day success plan in the offer packet that ties first-quarter objectives to measurable launch milestones.
2) Head of ML: require sign-off from Research/Applied ML (cc'ing them on final offer) for any compensation above the 14 band midpoint.

Also please cap total cash comp for any individual hire at the 75th percentile unless we have a clear retention/strategic rationale. If exceptions are needed, escalate to me with rationale + counteroffer plan.

Thanks —
Vivek
CEO Office

Aditya/Vivek —

APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS from People Ops perspective. A few operational items to lock down before we give recruiting greenlight:

- Offer authority matrix: please add signatory column (who will actually sign offer letters) — hiring manager cannot sign for VP/Product; VP of People must sign for any exec-level offers.
- Equity bands: the comp_bands_2027_v2.pdf looks fine but we need final RSU/grant language approved by Compensation. I've added comments in the Drive doc (link below).
- Immigration: if candidate relocation or visa sponsorship is likely, we need budget and timeline confirmed before moving to final offer.

I'll mark comments in the Drive doc and schedule a short 30-minute sync Monday to clear open items.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations

Quick question on runway implications —

I looked at Q3_exec_hiring_plan.xlsx. The hiring scenarios show a mid-case and a high-case; the high-case adds two director backfills in Q4 as dependencies. Before we lock commit, can Finance sign off on incremental burn and confirm this doesn't push cash runway under our target of 18 months? If Finance flags material runway risk, we'd need to reprioritize.

If Finance is needed for approval, loop in Eileen (cc'd in my calendar invite). I don't expect a stall but want visibility.

-Jonas
Head of Finance Strategy

Folks —

Thanks for the quick responses and the conditions — noted and addressed as follows:

- Added a signatory column to offer_signoff_matrix.csv and flagged VP People as required signatory for exec-level offers. See attached CSV.
- Added 90-day success plan template to the recruiter packet for VP Product; will require hiring manager to submit prior to offer acceptance.
- For Head of ML, we'll require Research/Applied ML written endorsement for any comp > band midpoint. I'll loop in Anika from Research later today to confirm process.
- Re: finance/runway: I ran the mid-case and high-case numbers with Finance; Eileen confirmed mid-case is green and high-case requires an approval call only if we decide to move the two director backfills up to Q3. I've attached a short summary tab in the spreadsheet.

Next steps:
1) Laura to confirm Compensation language and finalize equity grant wording by EOD Wed.
2) Vivek to confirm any exceptions over 75th percentile (if needed) before offers are extended.
3) Aditya to engage TalentAdvisors and begin active search for VP Product once items 1–2 are cleared.

If there are no further blocks, please reply with FINAL APPROVAL.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_exec_hiring_plan.xlsx (updated summary tab), offer_signoff_matrix.csv (updated), comp_bands_2027_v2.pdf
